## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if available.

## Validation

List the checks run, environment/version and observed result. State any untested paths.
For UI changes, include screenshots with test data only.

## Review

- [ ] Documentation reflects the final behavior.
- [ ] No generated APKs, keys, tokens, login codes or local logs are committed.
- [ ] Original third-party notices and source pins are preserved where applicable.
- [ ] Update/data preservation and access boundaries are considered where applicable.
